text.p: The Nigerian Stock Exchange has established an Internet window to display market information in the hope of attracting investors, a spokesman for the service said on Thursday.

"Basically, what the stock exchange wants to do is make its information available to stakeholders, companies, stockbrokers and institutional investors," said Abraham Esedafe of National Cash Register, the company that facilitated the connection.
He said instant information on the market would be available to subscribers.
"It could help increase foreign interest in the market," said Esedafe.
The NSE internet address is: www///nse.ngra.com
